mapper.select: SELECT uvp.id,uvp.video_id , uvp.master_id ,uvp.user_id,uvp.user_id,uvp.play_state,uvp.update_time,uvp.create_time FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v on uvp.video_id = v.id WHERE uvp.video_id = #{vid} ORDER BY uvp.create_time

SELECT u.id as user_id,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name, FROM gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_play vp ON u.id=vp.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON vp.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id=s.id left join gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id WHERE 1=1
AND u.id in
#{userId}
GROUP BY u.id

SELECT u.id as user_id, ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name, FROM gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_play vp ON u.id=vp.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON vp.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id=s.id left join gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id WHERE 1=1
AND u.id in
#{userId}
GROUP BY u.id

SELECT v.sub_id,v.id,v.video_name,v.video_time,v.video_source,COUNT(uvp.id) AS videoPlayNum,max(uvp.create_time) mostRecentlyDate, f.id as f_id,f.name as f_name,f.file_url as f_file_url,f.save_type as f_save_type ,f.video_long as f_video_long, f.thumb_nail_url as f_thumb_nail_url FROM gc_video v JOIN gc_user_video_play uvp ON v.id = uvp.video_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_file f on v.file_id=f.id WHERE s.sub_id = #{subId} AND uvp.user_id = #{userId} AND uvp.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY video_id

SELECT uvp.id, MAX(end_time ) AS endTime , MIN(start_time ) AS startTime, uvp.create_time,uvp.update_time FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.id = uvp.video_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_plays_node uvpn ON uvpn.videoplay_id = uvp.id WHERE uvp.video_id = #{vid} and uvp.user_id = #{userId} and uvp.master_id = #{masterId} and uvpn.videoplay_id is not null GROUP BY uvp.id

SELECT
topSub.name, topSub.id,
COUNT( v.sub_id ) AS watchNum, TO_CHAR(uvp.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_time FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON uvp.video_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id
JOIN ( SELECT id, NAME FROM gc_subject WHERE id IN
#{subId} ) AS topSub ON s.sub_id =topSub.id
WHERE uvp.user_id IN
#{userId}
AND uvp.master_id = #{masterId} AND TO_CHAR(uvp.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startTime} AND TO_CHAR(uvp.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endTime} GROUP BY
topSub.id,
TO_CHAR(uvp.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT COUNT( uvp.video_id ) AS viewNum,vs.videoNum,uvp.user_id AS id,v.sub_id AS subId FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON uvp.video_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT( v.id ) AS videoNum FROM gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id WHERE ( s.sub_id IN ( #{subId} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subId} ) ) GROUP BY s.sub_id ) AS vs WHERE uvp.master_id = #{masterId} AND ( s.sub_id IN ( #{subId} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subId} )) AND play_state = 1 GROUP BY uvp.user_id HAVING videoNum = viewNum

select *,count(b.video_id) as viewNum from ( SELECT vs.videoNum,uvp.user_id AS id,s.sub_id AS subId, uvp.video_id FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON uvp.video_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT( v.id ) AS videoNum,v.sub_id FROM gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id WHERE ( s.sub_id IN (
#{subIds} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subIds} ) ) GROUP BY s.sub_id ) AS vs on v.sub_id = vs.sub_id WHERE uvp.master_id = #{masterId} AND ( s.sub_id IN ( #{subIds} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subIds} )) AND play_state = 1 GROUP BY uvp.video_id ,uvp.user_id ) b GROUP BY b.subId,b.id HAVING videoNum = viewNum

select *,count(b.video_id) as viewNum from (
SELECT vs.videoNum, uvp.user_id AS id, s.id AS subjectId , uvp.video_id FROM gc_user_video_play uvp LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON uvp.video_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT( v.id ) AS videoNum,v.sub_id FROM gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id = s.id WHERE ( s.id IN (
#{subIds} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subIds} ) ) GROUP BY s.id ) AS vs on v.sub_id = vs.sub_id WHERE uvp.master_id = #{masterId} AND ( s.id IN ( #{subIds} ) OR v.sub_id IN ( #{subIds} )) AND play_state = 1 GROUP BY uvp.user_id, uvp.video_id ) b GROUP BY b.subjectId,b.id HAVING videoNum = viewNum

SELECT VIDEO_ID, MASTER_ID, USER_ID, MAX(PLAY_STATE) AS PLAY_STATE FROM (SELECT P.VIDEO_ID, P.MASTER_ID, P.USER_ID, P.PLAY_STATE FROM GC_USER_VIDEO_PLAY P WHERE P.USER_ID=#{userId} AND P.VIDEO_ID =#{videoId} GROUP BY P.VIDEO_ID, P.MASTER_ID, P.USER_ID, P.PLAY_STATE) t GROUP BY VIDEO_ID, MASTER_ID, USER_ID
SELECT g.video_id from gc_user_video_play g where g.master_id=#{portalId} and g.user_id=#{userId}
